title: A Bitter White House Feud, Even by Trump-Era Standards: Alina Mildon and Richard Grenell
summary: Two Trump allies — Alina Habba Mildon and Richard Grenell — are locked in a raging dispute that has its roots in the battle for a share of the spoils in Venezuela.
